clips.title: The story
paras: Having fought off the dig site's patrols and secured a sample of the strange ore Gerenzo ordered mined, Piznik dispatches adventurers to take the specimen to his contact, Ziz Fizziks. The delivery wraps up a risky act of corporate espionage deep in the Venture Company operations of Windshear Crag.

With his cover blown by the fight at the dig site, Piznik knows his time among the Venture Company crew at Windshear Crag has expired. Corporate management in Undermine does not take kindly to internal sabotage, prompting the nervous goblin to orchestrate his escape. Before slipping away to seek a new employer, he entrusts the Unidentified Ore mined under Gerenzo's orders to an outsider, ensuring the prized specimen gets delivered safely without drawing suspicion to himself.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I guess I'd better think about getting out of here, also. It won't take long for word of what happened here to spread to the higher ups, and I'm sure they wouldn't take too kindly to meeting me again.
I'll sneak out and meet with Ziz. Hopefully, he'll be able to find me a new job!
I'll try and clean up this mess a little, but you should take the ore sample to Ziz right away. He told me that he'd set up camp somewhere on the western side of Windshear Crag. Good luck.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Something I can help you with?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ahhh, I knew that I did the right thing by telling Piznik to stay behind. I'm sure the engineers in Undermine will be most interested to look at this...
Of course I'll want to keep a little piece for myself, but what they don't know won't hurt them, yes?
